content.short: Ubyx is a clearing network that lets banks and fintechs accept stablecoins and tokenized deposits at par.
content.description: Ubyx is an acceptance network for tokenized money that connects issuers, banks, fintechs and blockchains so regulated stablecoins and tokenized deposits can be redeemed at par, like cheque clearing. It is backed by Galaxy Ventures and Barclays. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Ubyx.
content.meta: Ubyx clears stablecoins and tokenized deposits at par for banks and fintechs, listed on Stable.
